items.postText:
August 10th is Agent Orange Awareness Day. This year marks the 65th anniversary of Agent Orange being sprayed in Vietnam for the first time.
To sponsor a candle and purchase shirts for Agent Orange Awareness Day, visit https://www.vvmf.org/Agent-Orange-Awareness-Day/

Leading up to that anniversary, we share the story of CMSgt James E. Henderson who returned from Vietnam, but was stationed at Bien Hoa Air Base – where the toxic defoliant known as Agent Orange was stored. James E. Henderson passed away on December 3, 2002, and was inducted into the In Memory program in 2004: https://bit.ly/3pIcJcL

To read the blog post written by his daughter, Heidi Zimmerman, Vice President, Programs & Communications at VVMF, visit https://bit.ly/3PJDPeP
To learn more about the In Memory program, visit vvmf.org/in-memory-program.
